V.''', commonly known as '''Hertha BSC''' ({{IPA|de|ˈhɛʁtaː beː ʔɛs t͡seː}}){{cite web |url=http://www.bundesliga.de/de/clubs/hertha-bsc/aktuelles/ |title=Hertha BSC: News des Clubs im Überblick |trans-title=Hertha BSC: News of the club at a glance |language=de |website=Bundesliga.de |publisher=[[Deutsche Fußball Liga]] |access-date=22 January 2017 |archive-date=7 June 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170607122724/http://www.bundesliga.de/de/clubs/hertha-bsc/aktuelles/ |url-status=live }} or '''Hertha Berlin''',{{cite web |url=http://www.bundesliga.com/en/clubs/hertha-berlin.jsp |title=Hertha Berlin – Profile |website=bundesliga.com |publisher=[[Deutsche Fußball Liga]] |access-date=22 January 2017 |archive-date=23 September 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170923161424/http://www.bundesliga.com/en/clubs/hertha-berlin.jsp |url-status=dead }} is a German professional football club based in [[Berlin]]. Hertha BSC plays in the [[2. Bundesliga]], the second tier of [[German football league system|German football]], following [[Promotion and relegation|relegation]] from the [[Bundesliga]] in [[2022–23 Bundesliga|2022–23]]. Hertha BSC was founded in 1892, and was a [[Founding Clubs of the DFB|founding member of the German Football Association]] in [[Leipzig]] in 1900. The team won the [[List of German football champions|German championship]] in [[1930 German football championship|1930]] and [[1931 German football championship|1931]]. Since 1963, Hertha's stadium has been the [[Olympiastadion (Berlin)|Olympiastadion]]. The club is known as ''Die Alte Dame'' in German, which translates to "The Old Lady". In 2002, the sports activities of the professional, amateur, and under-19 teams were separated into ''Hertha BSC GmbH & Co. KGaA''.{{cite web |url=http://www.herthabsc.de/de/footer/informationen/impressum/page/464----.html |title=Hertha BSC – Impressum |trans-title=Hertha BSC – Imprint |language=de |website=HerthaBSC.de |publisher=Hertha BSC |access-date=22 January 2017 |archive-date=19 March 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170319213007/http://www.herthabsc.de/de/footer/informationen/impressum/page/464----.html |url-status=live }}"}}
